description: This source file defines a WebSocket-based gateway communication layer for the OpenClaw project, including protocols, classes, and methods for managing WebSocket sessions, connection options, authentication, message handling, reconnection logic, and request/response handling.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: Protocol defining WebSocket task operations such as resume, cancel, send, receive, and sendPing.

classes.name: WebSocketSessioning
classes.description: Protocol for creating WebSocket tasks from a URLSession.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: A wrapper around a WebSocketTasking object providing methods for WebSocket communication and ping.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: A wrapper around a WebSocketSessioning object for dependency injection.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scopes, capabilities, commands, permissions, client info, and device identity inclusion.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: Enumeration of possible authentication sources for the gateway connection.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: An actor managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, including connect, disconnect, message handling, reconnection, and authentication.

methods.name: WebSocketTasking.cancel
methods.description: Cancels the WebSocket task with a close code and reason.

methods.name: WebSocketTasking.send
methods.description: Sends a message asynchronously over WebSocket.

methods.name: WebSocketTasking.receive
methods.description: Receives a message asynchronously over WebSocket.

methods.name: WebSocketTasking.receive (with completionHandler)
methods.description: Receives a message with a completion handler.

methods.name: WebSocketTaskBox.sendPing
methods.description: Sends a ping asynchronously to keep the connection alive.

methods.name: WebSocketSessioning.makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketTaskBox for a given URL.

methods.name: GatewayChannelActor.connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with reconnection logic.

methods.name: GatewayChannelActor.shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the WebSocket connection and cancels all tasks.

methods.name: GatewayChannelActor.request
methods.description: Sends a request over WebSocket and waits for a response.
